details: I1 reduce-scatter cross-core combine vs flat root; focus s=8,S=4,B=8
I2 tree combine idea: two-level tree reduce on 2-D row-group rects vs flat root
I3 compact stat gather: collapse+transpose at contributor, 128B payload instead of 4KB

Bench design: resident-shard row-group, absolute tile bases (TileOffset Set) so sumsq(b+1) can precede scale(b); levers = PIPELINE (depth-2 sq/gather/bcast/recip) and STAT_ROWS greater than APPLY_ROWS (coarse stat, fine apply). gamma dropped, held constant across variants.

tree_combine bake-off: flat_root (op current) vs tree (2-level, K-fanin subgroups). Inline-kernel ProgramDescriptor + pytest in perf_experiments/tree_combine. Stage-1 = raw pairwise add_tiles (ReduceWithinTile::Skip unreachable in ckl::reduce), stage-2 = the op-identical reduce+finalize.

compact_stat_gather bench: 4 modes (raw4k baseline, collapse4k, collapse2k faces, row128b transposed+REDUCE_COL). Found prior art in dit_fused_distributed_rmsnorm packed_ag path. transpose_dest is the key primitive.
WIN: 8x4 s=32 B=1 flat 4467 -> tree 3473 ns (1.286x); 7x4 s=28 flat 4195 -> 3461 (1.212x); 8x1 x8groups B=8 K=4 flat 14867 -> 13222 (1.124x). PCC identical 0.99999, max_rel_err identical. Spread <3%.

Bench compiles and is correct first try. focus_base_b8 PCC 0.999844, focus_pipe_b8 PCC 0.999844 (bit-identical arithmetic). Aggregate summary min=57939 max=68083 over the two -> pipelining looks like ~-15pct. Need per-case CSV.

reduce_scatter_combine: 3 kernels + bench.py + pytest; variants flat_root/scatter_root/scatter_mcast(+barrier). Found capability gap: ReceiverPipe cannot wait a COUNT of senders (Counter waits ++round_).

perf_experiments/scale_gamma_fusion: 7 variants (two_pass, dest_srca, dest_srcb, sfpu_dest, sfpu_dest_norc, sfpu_raw, sfpu_bcast_raw); found api/compute/sfpu_binary_bcast.h sfpu_mul_bcast_row (docs require fp32_dest_acc_en=true)

focus s8/S4/B8/nb4 64 cores: flat_root=64958ns, scatter_root=32353ns (2.01x), scatter_mcast=59289ns (1.10x), scatter_mcast_barrier=71862ns (0.90x). All pcc identical 0.996329. Hypothesis: 8 concurrent 1-tile multicasts + mcast atomics on one line contend (path reserve); funnel-to-root broadcast is far better.

MEASURED REGRESSION at s*B=8 (0.93x/0.88x/0.96x/0.95x) = the s=8 B=1 decode line. Best K = divisor of s nearest sqrt(s) (=rect_w on the flagged rects); U-shaped in K so the lever is fan-in, not root math. PCC/max-rel-err unchanged vs flat everywhere.

focus: flat_root 64980, flat_root_hs 65057, scatter_root 33784, scatter_root_hs 32184 (2.0x), scatter_mcast 64667 (NULL - concurrent 1-tile multicasts contend), scatter_ucast 36126 (1.80x), scatter_mcast_barrier 73352, scatter_ucast_barrier 51753. Winner: scatter_root (scatter the reduce, keep single-sender mcast_pipe broadcast).

Run2 reproduces run1 within 50ns on all 20 cells (noise <0.1pct on the big shapes). Added short geometry (2048x1024, 8 tile-rows/core): base_b4 18887 pipe_b4 16996 (-10.0pct), base_b8 (1 rt) 17781, coarse8_b4 17916, pipe_coarse8_b4 17843 (byte-identical, flat). Findings: levers are SUBSTITUTES not additive; decoupling stat from apply is a NULL on a resident shard (coarse16_b8 == base_b16 in ns AND L1); L1 wall verbatim = static CB region clashes with L1 buffers, CB region ~937KB because the two resident shards take the top 512KB.

s2_B8 46186/36316(1.27x); s4_B8 56949/31411(1.81x); s16_B8 81421/111184(0.73x REGRESSION all scatter variants); s8_B4 35029/25969(1.35x); s8_B1 12583/13738(0.92x); s8_B32 baseline build FAILED (L1: cb_gathered s*B=256 fp32 pages=1MB). Next: ablate the writer gather signal (1 mcast atomic vs num_owners unicast atomics) to explain the s16 regression.

Fusion WINS at B=1 many-blocks (1,4): 16231->13046 (0.80x); (1,5) 14259->12599. LOSES at B>=8 (few blocks) and at true decode R=1 (1066->1352). CORRECTNESS BUG: dest_srca AND dest_srcb pcc 0.9866 at S=8/DEST_BLOCK=8 (two_pass + sfpu_bcast_raw correct on same data) -> DestReuseBinary wrong at block_size==DEST_AUTO_LIMIT. sfpu_bcast_raw correct at fp32_dest_acc=False but 1.8-3.7x slower

Partial-landing-tile schemes need an ORDERING EDGE: the root zeroes the landing buffer at boot while contributors write into it from other cores. At s=8 the 256KB zero WIPED landed partials (1/rms inflated 3.5x, pcc 0.048). Fixed with a landing_ready semaphore (root inc_multicast after zero+barrier; every contributor writer wait_min(1) once). MODE2 now byte-identical to MODE1.

The s16 regression was MY implementation, not the topology: noc_semaphore_inc_multicast (mcast atomic path reservation) for the gather signal. Swapping to num_owners unicast atomics: s16_B8 99127 -> 40524 ns (0.82x -> 2.01x); focus 30313 -> 29014 (2.24x). scatter_root_usig is the recommended option.

WIN. scatter_root_usig vs flat_root: s2_B8 1.28x, s4_B8 1.87x, focus(s8_B8) 2.25x (64965->28890), s16_B8 2.01x, s28_B8 2.02x, s32_B8 1.84x, s8_B4 1.69x, s8_B32 baseline INFEASIBLE(L1) vs 24956, s8_B1 0.92x, s32_B1 0.95x. Exception: B==1 (num_owners==1) -8pct. Trap: mcast atomic gather signal regresses at s>=16.

Green: 10/10 cases pass, all variants correctness-gated. Artifact ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/reduce_scatter_combine/ (uncommitted). Verdict WIN 2.25x on focus for scatter_root_usig; exception B==1.

interm_cb_bulk (pass1 -> 1-block interm CB with ONE reserve/push, no sync_pack_to_unpack, two independent DEST windows): 8836->8621 (0.976x) focus; 0.887-0.996x across the whole sweep, NO regression, pcc 0.99998. Costs BLOCK_TILES pages of L1. interm_cb (PerBlockSize lifecycle) regresses 13-14% whenever DEST_BLOCK==1. DestReuse bug reconfirmed at S=8 B=8 and S=16 B=1 -> trigger is block_size==DEST_AUTO_LIMIT

Final: 3rd confirm 8848 -> 8624 (0.975x). Verdict: fusion-by-DEST-reuse and fusion-by-SFPU both REGRESS (math-thread bound); the win is removing the per-block sync via a bulk-lifecycle intermediate CB. Artifact: ttnn/ttnn/operations/rms_norm/perf_experiments/scale_gamma_fusion/
